title: Refuse to start the streamable HTTP transport without authentication on non-loopback hosts
description: In src/transports/streamableHttp.ts, turn shouldWarnAboutHttpHost() (lines 156-160), which today only logs a warning when httpHost is 0.0.0.0, :: or another non-loopback address, into a startup check that fails. If transport is http and no authentication credential from task 1 is configured, startup must throw a clear error and exit non-zero. The only exception is an explicit opt-out flag (for example an allow-unauthenticated setting, default false) that is honoured only when httpHost is 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1. Keep the monitoring server's health endpoints reachable so runtime probes and Kubernetes liveness checks still work. Update the httpHeaders and host descriptions in src/common/config/userConfig.ts and the --httpHeaders/MDB_MCP_HTTP_HEADERS entry in server.json so they no longer describe authentication as optional. Constraint: the AWS deploy path sets MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0, so this task must merge together with task 4's deployment configuration or before it, never ship to qa or prod alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting the server with MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http, MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0 and no auth credential exits with a non-zero code and logs an error naming the missing authentication setting; no port is left listening.
Starting with MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0 and the opt-out flag set still exits non-zero, while 127.0.0.1 with the opt-out flag starts and logs a warning.

Re-running probe-agent-graph on mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit does not produce AGENT-MCP-01 for src/transports/mcpHttpServer.ts (fingerprint e2309a05bd40d959bd42ffc15c9c61f16d7b004630e71f9a9a515640a9d61dcb).

verificationMethod.description: After pinning the merge commit in applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server.json, run /probe-agent-graph example-co --app mcp-gateway. Expected: the SARIF export has no failing AGENT-MCP-01 result for the streamable/HTTP transport, and the observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.AA.S17 on this repo is satisfied.

rootCause.description: The streamable HTTP transport had no startup safeguard. Binding to a network interface without authentication is only logged by shouldWarnAboutHttpHost(), so a deployment like the AWS Dockerfile's 0.0.0.0 bind comes up with an open /mcp endpoint.
